incidents.limitation: Historical customer-credential theft; current live authentication and security posture unverified.
incidents.remediation: Not a disclosed Mailtrap platform compromise; customers rotate leaked credentials. Mailtrap later added token expiry and recipient-domain allowlists.
incidents.summary: Researchers reported Mailtrap and other ESP customer SMTP/API credentials for sale on cybercrime forums, attributed to infostealers and credential stuffing rather than a Mailtrap backend intrusion.

research.qualityRationale: Read-only account, project, sandbox, and contact-list inventory with documented Bearer auth and official current paths.
research.searchCoverage: Official Mailtrap OpenAPI documents HTTPS host https://mailtrap.io and Authorization: Bearer. GET /api/accounts, GET /api/projects, GET /api/sandboxes, and GET /api/contacts/lists were confirmed on 2026-09-13. Operator is Railsware Products Studio LLC (US). Symfony CVE-2026-45755 and 2024 stolen-credential marketplace reports were distinguished from a Mailtrap platform breach. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

selection.ownership: Railsware Products Studio LLC, Pasadena, California, United States (Mailtrap.io). Parent studio Railsware originated in Ukraine with offices in Poland. The reviewed edition is the global API at mailtrap.io, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official Mailtrap API (HTTPS host https://mailtrap.io, Bearer and Api-Token auth, GET /api/accounts, GET /api/projects, GET /api/sandboxes, GET /api/contacts/lists), Railsware Products Studio LLC US identity, and dated incident search (Mailtrap + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. Symfony CVE-2026-45755 is a third-party Mailtrap mailer webhook parser bug, not a Mailtrap platform compromise. 2024 reports of stolen customer SMTP/API credentials sold on cybercrime forums describe infostealer/credential-stuffing of customer secrets, not a Mailtrap backend breach. No qualifying current unresolved Mailtrap compromise was identified; this is not a breach-free claim.
